runtime_counts_policy: Read the actual pass/fail/skip/todo/expect/Ran summaries and per-test observations. Mismatches remain NOT_PASS; do not fill counts from this plan.
complete_log_policy: Require completed supplied test+cleanup job metadata, exact run/S/branch identities, matching caller-provided full raw log SHA/bytes, explicit collector attestation of the complete GitHub Actions test-job log, one Bun banner and one final summary set.
positive_control_policy: Exactly one actual omni positive control line, verdict pass or not applicable; record the actual verdict and do not treat not applicable as proof of omni spawning.

metric.expected_order: AB then BA repeated three times

performance_limits: Uniform eight-value unit corpus, not installed workload frequency.
Durations are observed in this job only; no prediction of UI margin or installed acceptance.
All six alternating samples are retained; no fastest-run selection or outlier deletion.
Performance ratio is not a test-pass criterion.
Measured totals exclude the separate warm-up and unrelated test work.
No local product execution or benchmark is permitted by this normalizer.
run_id_basis: Actual dispatch metadata supplied by root; no runtime result inferred.
normalizer_syntax_check: Python AST parsed; normalizer not executed on any log.
